_doc: Enemy tanks (brief 2.4). Owner: rules. Light tanks hold 120-140 px (the brief's 90-140 with the closest 30 px cut: below about 115 px the gun cannot depress onto them; a Ram still reaches them, 120 + 24 px lunge). Schema: TankContentSchema.validate_enemies. HP and counts scale by the tank's enemy_scale (tanks.json; counts rounded, at least 1). hold_px runs from the hull's nearer end to the enemy's near edge. light_mult: the factor on light shells and secondaries. Muzzles and hit boxes (the dug-in's turret, the Behemoth's bogies and turret) are geometry: assets/tank/rigs.json through TankGeometry. G1 tuning against the brief (details in docs/decisions/tank.md): guns light 2.5 at 50% (4 at 60%), medium 5 at 60% (8 at 70%), destroyer 11 every 9 s at 75% (15 / 8 s / 90%), dug-in 7 at 60% (10 at 75%), heavy 9 at 60% and 100 HP (12 at 75%, 160 HP), Behemoth bogies 50 HP and turret 200 HP (100 / 300), stop_px 150 (120), main gun 16 at 75%, secondary 2 at 50% (3 at 60%). G2 balance iteration 1 (docs/decisions/tank.md Balance iteration 1): medium HP 64 (brief 80), guns dug-in 5 / medium 4 / destroyer 9 / heavy 7 / Behemoth main 13, Behemoth turret HP 270. Added keys: linger_s (a raider breaks off after this long on station and is gone with no credit), shell_speed_px_s (enemy shells fly straight at this speed), boss.main.hit.
